# Balaji Nivesh

> Balaji Nivesh Private Limited — AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor | ARN-173142, offering financial planning tools, calculators, investor education, and distribution of mutual funds, SIF, AIF and PMS. Educational content only — not investment advice.
